g.text: Gain and phase margins are read at different Bode crossings

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Negative unity-feedback example with one gain crossover and one phase crossover. GM_dB=−20log₁₀|L(jω_pc)|; PM=180°+angle L(jω_gc). This example has
negative margins and an unstable closed loop at gain 10. Multiple crossings, right-half-plane poles or delay require a fuller stability assessment.
